semantic_insights: The record carefully separates released data, dated source snapshots, and anticipated content, avoiding an unsupported assertion that all planned modalities are already available.
Historical admissions, current admissions, radiology admissions, and image counts use different dates or units; the text provides no basis for declaring them contradictory.
The project-level goal of public availability is distinguished from current controlled access and a signed licensing requirement.
The GitHub project's MIT license is explicitly prevented from becoming an unsupported dataset-license claim.
Current OMOP data, named format standards, and validated mapping tools provide meaningful interoperability evidence without proving complete harmonization of every planned modality.
Q13 and Q19 have different anchors: limited update metadata supports Q19 partial credit, while the missing version identifier and preservation plan leave Q13's middle-band threshold unmet.
All conditional applicability remains unknown under the empty caller context; clinical content was used to assess documentation quality, not to manufacture applicability declarations.
